findings.description: The application returns no Content-Security-Policy header. Injected third-party JavaScript executes with full origin authority and can exfiltrate DOM inputs, cookies, and tokens without restriction.
findings.recommendation: Deploy a strict CSP enforcing default-src 'self', script-src with cryptographic nonces, and a restricted connect-src.
findings.title: Content-Security-Policy Header Missing

remediation.apache_config:
# Apache security configuration (ScriptSentinel hardened)
Header set Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-{NONCE}' http://localhost:8001; script-src-elem 'self' 'nonce-{NONCE}' http://localhost:8001; connect-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https:; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; report-uri /api/csp-report"
Header set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
Header set X-Frame-Options "DENY"
Header set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

compliance.requirement: All payment page scripts must be authorized, justified, and integrity-verified.
compliance.status: PASS with generated SRI tags and explicit script inventory.

compliance.requirement: Change- and tamper-detection mechanism for payment page HTTP headers and contents.
compliance.status: PASS when script hash drift monitoring and CSP reporting are active.

remediation.hardened_csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-{NONCE}' http://localhost:8001; script-src-elem 'self' 'nonce-{NONCE}' http://localhost:8001; connect-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https:; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; report-uri /api/csp-report

issues.message: Script 'http://localhost:8001/js/acme.js' is loaded without a Subresource Integrity attribute. Any upstream vendor compromise executes without cryptographic verification.
